raw.description: 自身每次在场首次使用攻击技能时获得1层渐烬并吸取对手最大体力的1/3，若对手免疫受到的固定伤害、百分比伤害则本场战斗此效果无视时点条件|自身每次在场对手首次使用攻击技能时当回合自身受到的攻击伤害减少50%，若对手当次攻击微弱自身则对手下次属性技能无效|自身受到致死伤害时，消耗自身的渐烬以主动恢复全部体力，恢复成功自身解除所处的异常状态、能力下降状态，免疫下1次受到的攻击，每消耗1层渐烬，己方获得1层天烬海，之后本场战斗自身渐烬的上限视为0|（boss无效）

review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.rationale: 五项回答当前魂印部分已明确；实际免疫永久拓时点与保1/即时重生/渐烬顺序均用真实状态检查。
review.singleBehavior: 首次实际攻击得渐烬并按敌maxHP/3比例理论吸取；任一真实固粉免疫后永久改为每次实际攻击。每5层先制1及层红10%保留；先保1、再即时技能重生，仍死亡才消费全部渐烬主动回复，成功清异常清弱授1免攻；无论回复成功均转等海并上限0，失败死亡消逝继续正常。敌首次攻击当回减红半与微弱封属性保留，当前双方天海烧伤冻结及真实击败消逝已实装。
review.deferredBehavior: 真实重新登场的双方首次机会；渐烬上限按双方真实阵亡精灵数每只加5；己方天烬海队伍共享与跨离场保留，灰蛾不在场每回合减1层。
review.trigger: 每次在场；双方每有1只精灵阵亡；己方获得天烬海且灰蛾不在场
futureMechanisms: 真实换宠和首次机会生命周期
己方共享天烬海跨场及场下递减

success.name: 4912真实2099首次实际攻击得1渐烬并最大HP三分一百分比吸取理论魂印回复，属性/血药/控制不消费，MISS和红免疫仍属使用
success.assertion: test('4912真实2099首次实际攻击得1渐烬并最大HP三分一百分比吸取理论魂印回复，属性/血药/控制不消费，MISS和红免疫仍属使用',()=>{for(const mode of['hit','status','potion','control','miss','redimmune']){const s=make({move:10086,soul:true,hp:1000,loadout:[10086,20182,29372,29373,38426]});if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=1;if(mode==='miss'){delete s.fighters[0].effects['攻击必中'];timer(s,1,'概率闪避',{chance:100});}if(mode==='redimmune')timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(s,mode==='status'?20182:mode==='potion'?null:10086,20309);const yes=['hit','miss','redimmune'].includes(mode);assert.equal(st(s).embers,yes?1:0);assert.equal(st(s).ownFirst,yes);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),yes?3000:0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,yes?4000:mode==='potion'?1250:1000);}});

success.name: 4912真实2099普通不免疫首次后不重复，渐烬每层红伤10%与每5层全技能先制1，5层基底上限与0上限
success.assertion: test('4912真实2099普通不免疫首次后不重复，渐烬每层红伤10%与每5层全技能先制1，5层基底上限与0上限',()=>{const s=make({move:10086,soul:true,hp:1000});turn(s,10086,20309);turn(s,10086,20309);assert.equal(st(s).embers,1);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),0);for(const n of[1,5]){const a=make({move:10086,soul:true}),b=make({move:10086});Object.assign(st(a),{embers:n,ownFirst:true});turn(a,10086,20309);turn(b,10086,20309);assert.ok(sum(a)>=Math.floor(sum(b)*(1+.1*n)));assert.ok(sum(a)<=Math.ceil(sum(b)*(1+.1*n)));assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,n===5?1:0);}const cap=make({move:10086,soul:true});st(cap).embers=5;assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[2099].abilities.gain({a:cap.fighters[0],round:1}),0);assert.equal(st(cap).embers,5);st(cap).embers=0;st(cap).capZero=true;assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[2099].abilities.gain({a:cap.fighters[0],round:1}),0);assert.equal(st(cap).embers,0);});

success.name: 4912真实2099对手首次实际攻击本回红伤减半、后续不减，弱属性时源计次封下一次属性且保留异源
success.assertion: test('4912真实2099对手首次实际攻击本回红伤减半、后续不减，弱属性时源计次封下一次属性且保留异源',()=>{const a=make({move:10086,soul:true}),b=make({move:10086});turn(a,10086,10127);turn(b,10086,10127);assert.ok(sum(a,'attack',1)>=Math.floor(sum(b,'attack',1)*.5));assert.ok(sum(a,'attack',1)<=Math.ceil(sum(b,'attack',1)*.5));turn(a,10086,10127);turn(b,10086,10127);assert.equal(sum(a,'attack',1),sum(b,'attack',1));const weak=make({move:10086,soul:true,enemySource:require('../research/BATCH-4816-REMAINING/4908/snapshot.json'),enemyLoadout:[11961,20030,29362,38411,29364]});weak.fighters[1].counts.nextStatusInvalid=2;turn(weak,10086,11961);assert.equal(st(weak).events.find(e=>e.kind==='foe-first').weak,true);assert.equal(weak.fighters[1].counts.nextStatusInvalid,3);const speed=weak.fighters[1].stages.spe;turn(weak,10086,20030);assert.equal(weak.fighters[1].counts.nextStatusInvalid,2);assert.equal(weak.fighters[1].stages.spe,speed);});

success.name: 4912真实2099成功致死魂印主动回满消耗全部已备渐烬、解除异常负级、授源免攻1、天海等层及上限0，技能禁疗不封锁
success.assertion: test('4912真实2099成功致死魂印主动回满消耗全部已备渐烬、解除异常负级、授源免攻1、天海等层及上限0，技能禁疗不封锁',()=>{const s=make({move:10086,soul:true,aStats:{def:1},bStats:{atk:9999},loadout:[10086,20182,29372,29373,38426]});turn(s,10086,20309);assert.equal(st(s).embers,1);s.fighters[0].hp=1;s.fighters[0].stages.spa=-2;s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']=3;timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');turn(s,10086,10127);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);assert.equal(st(s).embers,0);assert.equal(st(s).capZero,true);assert.equal(st(s).sea,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.spa,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.attackNullify,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.deathResolved,undefined);const loss=s.damageEvents.find(e=>e.round===2&&e.type==='attack'&&e.targetSide===0);assert.ok(loss.settledDamage>9000);assert.equal(loss.hpLoss,1);turn(s,20182,10127);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.attackNullify,0);turn(s,20182,10127);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.vanished,true);assert.ok(s.vanishEvents.some(e=>Number(e.species)===4912));});

success.name: 4912天烬海当前双方烧伤每回合数不减少、其他异常正常到期且烧伤实际持续扣HP，双来源海不重复延长
success.assertion: test('4912天烬海当前双方烧伤每回合数不减少、其他异常正常到期且烧伤实际持续扣HP，双来源海不重复延长',()=>{const s=make({move:20182,soul:true});st(s).sea=1;s.fighters[1].soulState.moth2099={sea:2};for(const f of s.fighters){f.ailments['烧伤']=2;f.ailments['中毒']=2;}let last=9000;for(let r=1;r<=3;r++){turn(s,20182,20309);for(const f of s.fighters)assert.equal(f.ailments['烧伤']-s.round+1,2);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].hp<last);last=s.fighters[0].hp;if(r>=2)for(const f of s.fighters)assert.equal(f.ailments['中毒'],undefined);}assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>f.hp>0));});

success.name: 4912天烬海当前真正击败敌方后消逝，瞬时主动恢复不是击败，已备5层致死全消费为5海与普通回复倍率
success.assertion: test('4912天烬海当前真正击败敌方后消逝，瞬时主动恢复不是击败，已备5层致死全消费为5海与普通回复倍率',()=>{const s=make({move:10086,soul:true,targetHp:1});Object.assign(st(s),{sea:1,ownFirst:true,capZero:true});turn(s,10086,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stats.maxHp,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.vanished,true);const p=make({move:10086,soul:true,hp:1,aStats:{def:1},bStats:{atk:9999}});Object.assign(st(p),{embers:5,ownFirst:true});timer(p,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:.5});turn(p,10086,10127);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].hp,4500);assert.equal(st(p).embers,0);assert.equal(st(p).sea,5);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.vanished,undefined);});

success.name: 4912实际免疫解锁后续攻击、恢复失败消费转海、保1及即时重生存活不消费渐烬
success.assertion: test('4912实际免疫解锁后续攻击、恢复失败消费转海、保1及即时重生存活不消费渐烬',()=>{for(const mode of['immune','heal-fail','floor','rebirth']){const s=make({move:10086,soul:true,hp:1,aStats:{def:1},bStats:{atk:9999}});Object.assign(st(s),{embers:1,ownFirst:mode!=='immune'});if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');if(mode==='heal-fail')timer(s,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:1});if(mode==='floor')timer(s,0,'致命保留',{hp:1});if(mode==='rebirth')s.fighters[0].soulState.rebirth2243={armed:true};turn(s,10086,10127);if(mode==='immune'){assert.equal(st(s).timingFree,true);assert.equal(st(s).sea,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);}if(mode==='heal-fail'){assert.equal(st(s).embers,0);assert.equal(st(s).capZero,true);assert.equal(st(s).sea,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,0);}if(['floor','rebirth'].includes(mode)){assert.equal(st(s).embers,1);assert.equal(st(s).sea,0);assert.equal(st(s).capZero,false);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='floor'?1:9000);}}});

success.name: 4912全部17招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制状态，2099原生首次攻击与火系消费
success.assertion: test('4912全部17招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制状态，2099原生首次攻击与火系消费',()=>{require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true}),pp=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]),compiled.operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]));turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.moth2099.ownFirst,['physical','special'].includes(m.kind));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].type,m.fifth?'虫':source.type);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}});

success.name: 4912已答实际任一固粉免疫后永久改为每次实际攻击，免疫持有查询或零伤输入不冒充实际免疫，控制/属性/药剂不触发
success.assertion: test('4912已答实际任一固粉免疫后永久改为每次实际攻击，免疫持有查询或零伤输入不冒充实际免疫，控制/属性/药剂不触发',()=>{for(const mode of['fixed','percent','query','zero']){const s=make({move:10086,soul:true,hp:1000,loadout:[10086,20182,29372,29373,38426]});turn(s,10086,20309);assert.equal(st(s).embers,1);timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0){assert.equal(c.damageImmune(c.t,'percent'),true);if(mode!=='query')c.hurt(c.t,mode==='zero'?0:100,'实际免疫探针',mode==='percent'?'percent':'fixed');}},()=>turn(s,20182,20309));const freed=['fixed','percent'].includes(mode);assert.equal(!!st(s).timingFree,freed);assert.equal(st(s).immunityEvents?.length??0,freed?1:0);delete s.fighters[1].effects['固定百分比免疫'];turn(s,10086,20309);assert.equal(st(s).embers,freed?2:1);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),freed?3000:0);if(freed){const before=st(s).embers;s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=s.round;turn(s,10086,20309);assert.equal(st(s).embers,before);turn(s,null,20309);assert.equal(st(s).embers,before);turn(s,20182,20309);assert.equal(st(s).embers,before);}}});

success.name: 4912已答首次比例吸取实际免粉即解锁，后续MISS和整招无效仍属实际攻击使用并持续理论回复
success.assertion: test('4912已答首次比例吸取实际免粉即解锁，后续MISS和整招无效仍属实际攻击使用并持续理论回复',()=>{for(const mode of['miss','invalid']){const s=make({move:10086,soul:true,hp:1000,hit:mode!=='miss'});timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');turn(s,10086,20309);assert.equal(st(s).timingFree,true);assert.equal(st(s).embers,1);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,4000);if(mode==='miss'){delete s.fighters[0].effects['攻击必中'];timer(s,0,'攻击必失');}else timer(s,0,'skillBlock');turn(s,10086,20309);assert.equal(st(s).embers,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,7000);assert.equal(sum(s),0);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),0);}});

success.name: 4912已答致死回复失败仍消费全部渐烬转等海且上限0，清异常清弱免攻仅回复成功才授，最终被击败消逝正常结算
success.assertion: test('4912已答致死回复失败仍消费全部渐烬转等海且上限0，清异常清弱免攻仅回复成功才授，最终被击败消逝正常结算',()=>{for(const mode of['cut','block']){const s=make({move:10086,soul:true,hp:1,aStats:{def:1},bStats:{atk:9999}});Object.assign(st(s),{embers:2,ownFirst:true});s.fighters[0].stages.spa=-2;s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']=3;if(mode==='cut')timer(s,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:1});else timer(s,0,'四杀鬼囹');turn(s,10086,10127);assert.equal(st(s).embers,0);assert.equal(st(s).sea,2);assert.equal(st(s).capZero,true);assert.equal(st(s).events.find(e=>e.kind==='lethal-recovery').recovered,false);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.attackNullify??0,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.spa,-2);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.vanished,true);}});

success.name: 4912已答保1和即时技能重生先于渐烬：存活不消费、不转海、不设零上限，技能死亡回复失败后仍可渐烬恢复
success.assertion: test('4912已答保1和即时技能重生先于渐烬：存活不消费、不转海、不设零上限，技能死亡回复失败后仍可渐烬恢复',()=>{for(const mode of['floor','one-use-floor','rebirth','skill-recover','skill-fail']){const s=make({move:10086,soul:true,hp:1,aStats:{def:1},bStats:{atk:9999}});Object.assign(st(s),{embers:2,ownFirst:true});if(mode==='floor')timer(s,0,'致命保留',{hp:1});if(mode==='one-use-floor')s.fighters[0].soulState.nextLethalFloor=true;if(mode==='rebirth')s.fighters[0].soulState.rebirth2243={armed:true};if(mode.startsWith('skill'))timer(s,0,'死亡时技能回复');if(mode==='skill-fail')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');turn(s,10086,10127);const spent=mode==='skill-fail';assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode.includes('floor')?1:9000);assert.equal(st(s).embers,spent?0:2);assert.equal(st(s).sea,spent?2:0);assert.equal(st(s).capZero,spent);assert.equal(st(s).events.filter(e=>e.kind==='lethal-recovery').length,spent?1:0);const hit=s.damageEvents.find(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.targetSide===0);assert.ok(hit.settledDamage>9000);assert.equal(hit.hpLoss,mode.includes('floor')?0:1);if(mode==='rebirth')assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.rebirth2243.armed,false);}});

success.name: 4912已答消耗火系开启替换后致死令渐烬上限0，后续获得不再转海；外部先去火不能首次开启替换
success.assertion: test('4912已答消耗火系开启替换后致死令渐烬上限0，后续获得不再转海；外部先去火不能首次开启替换',()=>{const s=make({...row(2506),soul:true,aStats:{def:1},bStats:{atk:9999},loadout:[10086,20182,29372,29373,38426]});timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');turn(s,38426,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].type,'虫');assert.equal(st(s).fireConsumed,true);assert.equal(st(s).embers,1);assert.equal(st(s).timingFree,true);s.fighters[0].hp=1;turn(s,10086,10127);assert.equal(st(s).capZero,true);assert.equal(st(s).embers,0);assert.equal(st(s).sea,3);const sea=st(s).sea;turn(s,10086,20309);assert.equal(st(s).sea,sea);assert.equal(st(s).embers,0);const noFire=make({...row(2506)});noFire.fighters[0].type='虫';turn(noFire,38426,20309);const state=st(noFire);assert.equal(state.fireConsumed,undefined);assert.equal(state.events.at(-1).kind,'consume-fire-failed');E.SOULS.registry[2099].abilities.gain({a:noFire.fighters[0],round:noFire.round});assert.equal(state.embers,1);assert.equal(state.sea,0);});

success.name: 4912真实2099普通不免疫首次后不重复，渐烬每层红伤10%与每5层全技能先制1，5层基底上限与0上限
success.assertion: test('4912真实2099普通不免疫首次后不重复，渐烬每层红伤10%与每5层全技能先制1，5层基底上限与0上限',()=>{const s=make({move:10086,soul:true,hp:1000});turn(s,10086,20309);turn(s,10086,20309);assert.equal(st(s).embers,1);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),0);for(const n of[1,5]){const a=make({move:10086,soul:true}),b=make({move:10086});Object.assign(st(a),{embers:n,ownFirst:true});turn(a,10086,20309);turn(b,10086,20309);assert.ok(sum(a)>=Math.floor(sum(b)*(1+.1*n)));assert.ok(sum(a)<=Math.ceil(sum(b)*(1+.1*n)));assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,n===5?1:0);}const cap=make({move:10086,soul:true});st(cap).embers=5;assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[2099].abilities.gain({a:cap.fighters[0],round:1}),0);assert.equal(st(cap).embers,5);st(cap).embers=0;st(cap).capZero=true;assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[2099].abilities.gain({a:cap.fighters[0],round:1}),0);assert.equal(st(cap).embers,0);});

success.name: 4912天烬海当前真正击败敌方后消逝，瞬时主动恢复不是击败，已备5层致死全消费为5海与普通回复倍率
success.assertion: test('4912天烬海当前真正击败敌方后消逝，瞬时主动恢复不是击败，已备5层致死全消费为5海与普通回复倍率',()=>{const s=make({move:10086,soul:true,targetHp:1});Object.assign(st(s),{sea:1,ownFirst:true,capZero:true});turn(s,10086,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stats.maxHp,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.vanished,true);const p=make({move:10086,soul:true,hp:1,aStats:{def:1},bStats:{atk:9999}});Object.assign(st(p),{embers:5,ownFirst:true});timer(p,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:.5});turn(p,10086,10127);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].hp,4500);assert.equal(st(p).embers,0);assert.equal(st(p).sea,5);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.vanished,undefined);});

success.name: 4912基础重复降攻特攻与降速真实生效、免弱阻挡；魔眼害怕必附且免异消费
success.assertion: test('4912基础重复降攻特攻与降速真实生效、免弱阻挡；魔眼害怕必附且免异消费',()=>{for(const move of[20182,32116])for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make({move});if(immune)timer(s,1,'免弱');turn(s,move,20309);for(const k of keys)assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages[k],!immune&&(move===20182?['atk','spa'].includes(k):k==='spe')?-1:0);}for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make({move:20231});if(immune)s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(s,20231,20309);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],!immune);if(immune)assert.equal(s.fighters[1].counts.immune,0);}});

success.name: 4912/1616克制时获本系1.5，2331真实穿透攻击免疫且成功才清敌回合
success.assertion: test('4912/1616克制时获本系1.5，2331真实穿透攻击免疫且成功才清敌回合',()=>{const m=source.moves.find(m=>m.id===38424),strong=Object.keys(source.typeChart.rows).find(t=>E.typeEffectiveness(m.type,t,source.typeChart)>1);assert.ok(strong);for(const type of[strong,'普通']){const a=make(row(1616)),b=make({...row(1616),index:-1});for(const s of[a,b]){s.fighters[0].type='普通';s.fighters[1].type=type;}turn(a,38424,20117);turn(b,38424,20117);if(type===strong){assert.ok(sum(a)>=Math.floor(sum(b)*1.5));assert.ok(sum(a)<=Math.ceil(sum(b)*1.5));}else assert.equal(sum(a),sum(b));}for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make(row(2331));timer(s,1,'强化保护');if(immune)timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(s,38424,20117);assert.ok(sum(s)>0);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].effects['强化保护'],!immune);}});

interaction.assertion: test('4912天烬海当前真正击败敌方后消逝，瞬时主动恢复不是击败，已备5层致死全消费为5海与普通回复倍率',()=>{const s=make({move:10086,soul:true,targetHp:1});Object.assign(st(s),{sea:1,ownFirst:true,capZero:true});turn(s,10086,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stats.maxHp,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.vanished,true);const p=make({move:10086,soul:true,hp:1,aStats:{def:1},bStats:{atk:9999}});Object.assign(st(p),{embers:5,ownFirst:true});timer(p,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:.5});turn(p,10086,10127);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].hp,4500);assert.equal(st(p).embers,0);assert.equal(st(p).sea,5);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.vanished,undefined);});

interaction.name: 4912基础重复降攻特攻与降速真实生效、免弱阻挡；魔眼害怕必附且免异消费
interaction.assertion: test('4912基础重复降攻特攻与降速真实生效、免弱阻挡；魔眼害怕必附且免异消费',()=>{for(const move of[20182,32116])for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make({move});if(immune)timer(s,1,'免弱');turn(s,move,20309);for(const k of keys)assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages[k],!immune&&(move===20182?['atk','spa'].includes(k):k==='spe')?-1:0);}for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make({move:20231});if(immune)s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(s,20231,20309);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],!immune);if(immune)assert.equal(s.fighters[1].counts.immune,0);}});

interaction.assertion: test('4912/1616克制时获本系1.5，2331真实穿透攻击免疫且成功才清敌回合',()=>{const m=source.moves.find(m=>m.id===38424),strong=Object.keys(source.typeChart.rows).find(t=>E.typeEffectiveness(m.type,t,source.typeChart)>1);assert.ok(strong);for(const type of[strong,'普通']){const a=make(row(1616)),b=make({...row(1616),index:-1});for(const s of[a,b]){s.fighters[0].type='普通';s.fighters[1].type=type;}turn(a,38424,20117);turn(b,38424,20117);if(type===strong){assert.ok(sum(a)>=Math.floor(sum(b)*1.5));assert.ok(sum(a)<=Math.ceil(sum(b)*1.5));}else assert.equal(sum(a),sum(b));}for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make(row(2331));timer(s,1,'强化保护');if(immune)timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(s,38424,20117);assert.ok(sum(s)>0);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].effects['强化保护'],!immune);}});

success.assertion: test('4912全部17招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制状态，2099原生首次攻击与火系消费',()=>{require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true}),pp=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]),compiled.operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]));turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.moth2099.ownFirst,['physical','special'].includes(m.kind));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].type,m.fifth?'虫':source.type);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}});

success.assertion: test('4912全部17招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制状态，2099原生首次攻击与火系消费',()=>{require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true}),pp=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]),compiled.operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]));turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.moth2099.ownFirst,['physical','special'].includes(m.kind));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].type,m.fifth?'虫':source.type);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}});

success.assertion: test('4912/58后两回必暴与843后两回全先制2均到期，125首个正红封顶170',()=>{for(const id of[58,843]){const s=make({...row(id),loadout:[21356,10086,29373,29372,38426]});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);for(let r=2;r<=4;r++){let crit;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterAttack'&&c.a.side===0)crit=c.crit;},()=>turn(s,10086,20309));if(id===58)assert.equal(crit,r<=3);else assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,r<=3?2:0);}}const s=make({...row(125),aStats:{def:1},bStats:{atk:9999}});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,10127);assert.equal(sum(s,'attack',1),170);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,8830);});

success.assertion: test('4912关联125精确170：原生多段共170、额外完整技能另170，固定50独立且四回自然到期',()=>{const s=make({...row(125),aStats:{def:1,spd:1},bStats:{atk:9999,spa:9999},loadout:[29372,10086,20182,29373,38426],enemyLoadout:[10713,10127,10716,20309,37911]});turn(s,29372,20309);const old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;let replayed=false;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(p,o,c){const out=old.run(p,o,c);if(p==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===1&&!replayed){replayed=true;c.reproduceSkillComponent(c.moveDefinition(key(10716)));}return out;}};try{turn(s,10086,10713);}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}assert.equal(sum(s,'attack',1),340);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed',1),50);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,8610);for(let r=3;r<=5;r++){turn(s,10086,10127);if(r<=4)assert.equal(sum(s,'attack',1),170);else assert.ok(sum(s,'attack',1)>170);}});

success.assertion: test('4912全部17招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制状态，2099原生首次攻击与火系消费',()=>{require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true}),pp=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]),compiled.operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]));turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.moth2099.ownFirst,['physical','special'].includes(m.kind));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].type,m.fifth?'虫':source.type);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}});

success.name: 4912/2506真实消耗火变虫并替换渐烬为2海，上限0后不授海，原本无火不启用替换
success.assertion: test('4912/2506真实消耗火变虫并替换渐烬为2海，上限0后不授海，原本无火不启用替换',()=>{const s=make(row(2506));turn(s,38426,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].type,'虫');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.moth2099.fireConsumed,true);E.SOULS.registry[2099].abilities.gain({a:s.fighters[0],round:s.round});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.moth2099.sea,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.moth2099.embers,0);s.fighters[0].soulState.moth2099.capZero=true;assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[2099].abilities.gain({a:s.fighters[0],round:s.round}),0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.moth2099.sea,2);const p=make(row(2506));p.fighters[0].type='虫';turn(p,38426,20117);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.moth2099.fireConsumed,undefined);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].type,'虫');E.SOULS.registry[2099].abilities.gain({a:p.fighters[0],round:p.round});assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.moth2099.embers,1);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.moth2099.sea,0);});

success.name: 4912已答消耗火系开启替换后致死令渐烬上限0，后续获得不再转海；外部先去火不能首次开启替换
success.assertion: test('4912已答消耗火系开启替换后致死令渐烬上限0，后续获得不再转海；外部先去火不能首次开启替换',()=>{const s=make({...row(2506),soul:true,aStats:{def:1},bStats:{atk:9999},loadout:[10086,20182,29372,29373,38426]});timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');turn(s,38426,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].type,'虫');assert.equal(st(s).fireConsumed,true);assert.equal(st(s).embers,1);assert.equal(st(s).timingFree,true);s.fighters[0].hp=1;turn(s,10086,10127);assert.equal(st(s).capZero,true);assert.equal(st(s).embers,0);assert.equal(st(s).sea,3);const sea=st(s).sea;turn(s,10086,20309);assert.equal(st(s).sea,sea);assert.equal(st(s).embers,0);const noFire=make({...row(2506)});noFire.fighters[0].type='虫';turn(noFire,38426,20309);const state=st(noFire);assert.equal(state.fireConsumed,undefined);assert.equal(state.events.at(-1).kind,'consume-fire-failed');E.SOULS.registry[2099].abilities.gain({a:noFire.fighters[0],round:noFire.round});assert.equal(state.embers,1);assert.equal(state.sea,0);});

success.assertion: test('4912/1978清强成功焚烬否则最大HP三分一百分比，保护失败保留强化；1675反强成功才技能禁疗',()=>{for(const mode of['none','boost','protected','immune']){const s=make(row(1978));if(mode!=='none')s.fighters[1].stages.def=2;if(mode==='protected')timer(s,1,'强化保护');if(mode==='immune')s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['焚烬'],mode==='boost');assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),mode==='boost'?0:3000);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.def,mode==='protected'?2:0);}for(const boost of[false,true]){const s=make(row(1675));if(boost)s.fighters[1].stages.atk=2;turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,boost?-2:0);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].effects['技能禁疗'],boost);}});

success.assertion: test('4912/919后手才封敌下轮属性，1664先手封低威力攻击而实际击败延长次轮',()=>{for(const last of[false,true]){const s=make({...row(919),aStats:{spe:last?50:500}});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20117);const old=s.fighters[1].stages.atk;turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,last?old:old+1);}const s=make(row(1664));let granted;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterAttack'&&c.a.side===0)granted=c.a.effects['低威力攻击无效']?.power;},()=>turn(s,s.auditMoveId,10127));assert.equal(sum(s,'attack',1),0);assert.equal(granted,120);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['低威力攻击无效'],undefined);const ko=make({...row(1664),targetHp:1});turn(ko,38426,20117);assert.equal(ko.fighters[1].hp,0);assert.equal(ko.fighters[0].effects['低威力攻击无效'].end,2);});
